provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: reviewed finite init/emptyDir Pod host lab

cases.task: Identify init completion as a prerequisite for the application reader.
Match volume name work across Pod,init and application mounts.
cases.expected: Both containers access the same /work emptyDir within one Pod.

cases.task: Use the exact teacher-provided finite fixture and retain UID,marker and restart count.
cases.expected: Same Pod UID/marker across the failed first and successful next application attempt.

cases.task: Replace only the recorded owned Pod under the host capability.
cases.expected: New Pod UID,new marker and fresh attempt sequence.

cases.task: Review a missing mount or denied write in prepare.
cases.expected: Application absence is explained by init failure;the smallest mount/permission repair is identified.

cases.task: Explain why this marker is neither persistent storage nor a backup.
cases.expected: emptyDir lifetime is tied to the Pod;durability and independent recovery require later storage/backup contracts.
